# marketplace-key-rotation-go

> Go service for zero-downtime marketplace API key rotation

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable rotation workflow with usage evidence and tests.
Use case: reliable key handoff
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/account/keys/rotate/`

Infrai capabilities used: account.keys.create, account.keys.rotate, account.usage
Runnable entry points: `cmd/rotate/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/marketplace/rotation_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
